criteria.requirement: Implement bidict.records.to_records/from_records with explicit key/value codec callables, a schema1 ordered pairs format and checked codec identifier. Preserve tuple/int/str/None keys and values through caller-defined JSON-compatible encodings, reject malformed or duplicate-after-decoding keys/values instead of silently dropping rows, and allow the caller to explicitly choose ordered/frozen/custom result classes. Never import classes or execute expressions from data; preserve source relationships and callback errors.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
